summary: The spacing defect is repaired, but revised answer banks favor a nearest-zero shortcut: 8/15 fresh successes versus a 20% guessing baseline. The actual batch radio also exhibits it. The other seven checks passed; previously affected stored radios are retired. Package files remain unchanged.

findings.description: The replacement arithmetic_bank disproportionately makes the correct slope the option nearest zero. Ignoring the function and target and choosing the smallest absolute answer succeeds on 4/5 discovery cases and 8/15 fresh unforced cases, versus a 20% guessing baseline. The fresh-case binomial upper tail is 0.00424. This is a probabilistic shortcut, not a universal key. All fresh cases survive delivery, and the actual batch’s sole radio exhibits it. The distractor radius floor and denominator weighting leave small correct slopes unusually close to zero.
findings.reproduction: From evidence_root run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python -B nearest_zero_regression.py; exit 1 reproduces 8/15 using easy slope_sqrt_radio seeds 764300..764314. Passing delivery-focused/accepted.json also reproduces the failure. Minimal actual-batch witness: seed 3173462203, a=7,b=37,t=-4. For y=sqrt(37+7x) at x=-4, choices are 7/6,31/13,-39/14,3,40/13. The smallest absolute value is the correct 7/6. See batch-records.json and render/question-004.png. The single witness alone is not treated as statistical proof.
findings.requested_change: Revise the family-wide arithmetic_bank construction so small correct slopes are not systematically distinguished by absolute magnitude. Address absolute-rank cues alongside signed rank and spacing while preserving source families, valid targets and deterministic replay. Retain the fresh-seed and explicit-candidate regression through delivery. Do not repair this by changing the seed or hand-picking a batch; the runner should regenerate its batch after package repair.
